limitations.summary: Learning classifiers from only positive and unlabeled data.
items: Learning classifiers from only positive and unlabeled data.

Every precision claim about RA-4M is structural: the gate rejects 11.3% of candidates, a rejection is a true negative up to box error, and predicates geometry cannot constrain are named and counted rather than checked (§ 4.1).
Per-relation precision is a genuine shortcoming: at any depth the baseline overreaches less, and a deployment that cannot tolerate a false edge should prefer a shorter graph.
